source.snippet: Shows an Incorrect API Key error...which is weird. Nothing on the status page. (EDIT: Added to incident page.) Per Twitter/X this appears to be widespread. [64 points, 70 comments on 'Tell HN: Codex Is Down']

problem_statement: Developers and teams building products on top of LLM APIs (e.g. OpenAI Codex) suffer unannounced outages that look like credential errors, with status pages lagging incident reality by hours — there is no independent real-time reliability monitor or alerting layer for AI API providers.
target_segment: Indie developers, agencies, and startups that have integrated LLM APIs into production products and sell or operate services dependent on API uptime
notes: 64 points and 70 comments indicate broad resonance. The commenter in item 49850798 explicitly states they 'sell LLM API usage' — a paying commercial operator. Outages that masquerade as auth errors waste engineering time and erode customer trust. An independent multi-provider LLM API status and latency monitor (think StatusPage but AI-API-specific, with webhook/PagerDuty alerts) is a clear solo-operator SaaS. Recurring subscription model plausible. Signal boosted by recency (Sep 25 2026).
